svg.title: How much annual water volume passes on high-flow days?
svg.desc: Each gauge retains its own complete calendar years and its own annual P95 threshold. Each year's quantity is the observed water volume carried by days at or above that year's daily-flow 95th percentile, divided by that same year's total water volume. Ties can make the high-flow group exceed 5% of days. Boxes span the across-year 25th–75th percentiles, with median center, observed minimum/maximum whiskers and open-diamond mean; one-year support remains a single value. The source table lists each gauge's exact years and counts. Water volumes are evaluated separately at every gauge.
